title: Russia charges air force deputy chief with taking large bribe
summary: Yuri Grekhov, 64, who oversaw procurement of aircraft, missiles and air defence systems and has been under EU sanctions since 2022, is a serving officer, unlike most of the more than a dozen senior defence figures detained since Andrei Belousov replaced Sergei Shoigu as defence minister in 2024.
